items.name: Roasted potatoes in olive oil
items.qty: 140 g eaten out of a 320 g baked batch (25g olive oil total, pre-bake; raw potato weight not given)
items.note: Oil (25g) assumed to distribute evenly through the whole post-bake batch — 140/320 = 43.75% of the dish, so ~10.9g of the oil and ~129g of potato flesh (standard baked-potato reference, ~94kcal/100g) came with this portion. Credits ~1.5mg vitamin E (olive oil), ~12.1mg vitamin C (potato).
